Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Effective: October 27, 2026 · Last updated: October 27, 2026

At a glance

Attention Museum requires no account and contains no ads or third-party analytics. Focus history, collections and preferences stay only on your iPhone; we cannot view them.

Network access is used only to download artwork images and process Pro purchases through the App Store and RevenueCat.

This policy covers the Attention Museum iOS app (the “App”) and this website, provided by the Attention Museum developer (“we”). Read it before use and contact us using the details below with any questions.

1. Information We Do Not Collect

  • We require no name, phone number, email or other identity information and provide no account system.
  • The App has no advertising SDK, third-party analytics or crash reporting, cross-app tracking or tracking permission requests.
  • The App does not access contacts, photos, location, microphone or camera.

2. Information Stored on Your Device

The following stays in the local app sandbox and is not uploaded to our servers. We do not operate servers for user data:

InformationPurpose
Focus historyStart time, duration and completion/interruption status, for timing, session recovery and collection progress.
Collection and artwork cacheCollected works and images, for the collection wall and offline viewing.
Gallery progress and preferencesCurrent artwork, selected duration, browsing position, whether onboarding has been read, and similar preferences.
Legacy notesReflections written in early versions, if any. They remain locally for compatibility; the current version neither displays nor edits them.

Settings → Reset All Progress clears collections, focus history, badges and gallery progress, without affecting membership. Deleting the App removes all local data. Deleted data cannot be recovered. If iCloud or computer backups are enabled, Apple may include local data in device backups; Apple controls this and we cannot access them.

This website stores your language choice locally in your browser to remember your preference, not for advertising or behavioral tracking. Clear it in your browser’s site-data settings.

3. Features Using the Network

1. Artwork downloads

Images are downloaded from public museum servers, currently The Metropolitan Museum of Art (images.metmuseum.org). As with any website, requests may reveal your IP address, request time and app identifier, such as AttentionMuseum/0.1. We send no identity-related information. The museum’s privacy policy governs its handling of those requests.

2. Pro purchases and restores

Apple handles payments through the App Store; we receive no payment-card or Apple Account details. The App uses RevenueCat, Inc.’s subscription service to verify Pro access:

  • RevenueCat generates an anonymous app user ID, unrelated to your identity;
  • It processes purchases and transactions (product, price, currency, purchase and expiry times), App Store receipts, and basic device/app technical data such as OS and app versions, region, language and IP address;
  • Use is limited to validating and restoring purchases, checking Pro access and displaying subscription management.

RevenueCat is based in the United States and may process information outside China, under its Privacy Policy. If subscriptions are disabled, the App does not initialize RevenueCat or send related network requests.

4. Notifications

The App may request notification permission only for local reminders when you leave a session. They are generated on-device, with no push service or device-token uploads. Declining does not change timing rules; change permission anytime in system settings.

5. Sharing and Export

Pro users can export posters created locally. A poster is sent only after you choose a destination in the system share sheet; recipients are responsible for their handling of the content.

6. Sharing, Transfer and Disclosure

Apart from Apple for payments, RevenueCat for entitlements and museum servers for image downloads, we do not share, sell, rent or publicly disclose your personal information. We cooperate with lawful requests from authorities only as necessary.

7. Your Rights

You can view, clear or delete most information directly on your device. Contact us for help requesting access, correction or deletion of RevenueCat’s anonymous purchase records. You can cancel subscriptions in the App Store and disable notifications in system settings. We respond within 15 working days.

8. Minors

The App is for the general public and is not specifically directed at children under 14. If under 14, read this policy with a guardian and obtain their consent before use; a guardian must handle purchases.

9. Security and Retention

Local data is protected by the iOS sandbox and device encryption. We store no focus or collection data on servers, so have no server-side retention period. Local data remains until you clear it or delete the App. RevenueCat retains purchase records under its policies and applicable law.

10. Policy Updates

If data processing changes, such as new network features, we will update this policy and its date. Material changes will be highlighted in the App or on this website.

11. Contact

For questions, comments or requests about this policy or your personal information, contact:

Attention Museum developer · Email: hello@txxy.in
